mlb.award_fan_vote_popularity.assessment: Formula defect: pop_i = log(votes) with '0 for players not listed' is undefined (log 0) and MLB only publishes the top vote-getters per Phase 1 update, so non-listed players are censored, not zero. 'team metro population' has no source or definition (Toronto, shared metros, units) and is described as a 'second term' without a coefficient. Phase 1 totals are only available for the ballot-leader list, so most finalists lack the value. Point-in-time is OK (July data precedes award votes) but pregame_knowable is honestly 'partial'. Only ~12 winners per league, 4 coefficients: heavy ridge needed. Agent judgement only.

mlb.award_fan_vote_popularity.measurement_fix: pop_i = log(V_i) where V_i = published Phase 1 fan votes of player i in the same season; if i is not on the published leader list set V_i = the lowest published total of his league-position list (censoring floor) and not_listed=1. Second term m_i = log(team metro/CMA population, latest census, millions). Model: P(i)=softmax(a1*OPS+_z + a2*HR_z + a3*pop_z + a4*m_z + a5*not_listed + a6*playoff) over club-nominee finalists, z within league-season, conditional logit on 2014-2025, ridge toward the production-only fit with penalty 3 seasons and a3,a4 shrunk hardest. As-of end of the regular season.

mlb.executive_award_team_improvement.assessment: x2 uses 'mean of ZiPS and PECOTA team projections': PECOTA is paywalled (Baseball Prospectus) and neither vintage is archived publicly, so the preseason value cannot be reconstructed historically; the preseason-frozen snapshot must be specified. x5 is ambiguous: whose fWAR counts for players traded away (only after leaving? full season?) and what 'acquired in prior 12 months' means at the season end, so it is not computable as written. x4 payroll needs a stated payroll source (Cot's; probe not confirmed). The 'only 8 winners' framing is correct (1 per season since 2018), so heavy shrinkage is appropriate. Point-in-time fine at season end. Agent judgement only.

mlb.executive_award_team_improvement.measurement_fix: For each club's top baseball-operations executive at season end: x1 = wins minus prior-season wins; x2 = wins minus FanGraphs preseason projected wins (ZiPS-based Depth Charts snapshot frozen before opening day; PECOTA dropped as paywalled); x3 = playoff flag; x4 = z-score within league-season of wins per $10M opening-day payroll (Cot's); x5 = fWAR accrued with the acquiring club, from acquisition date to season end, by players acquired by trade or FA in the prior 12 months, minus fWAR those traded-away players accrued for their new clubs after the trade. P(i)=softmax(b*x), conditional logit on 2018-2025 winners, ridge penalty 3 seasons. As-of last regular-season day.

mlb.opposing_probable_starter_vintage.assessment: Recipe is mostly computable and point-in-time safe by construction, and mlb_statsapi_sched probe (hydrate=probablePitcher,lineups) supports the endpoint. Weaknesses: (1) pitchHand is not part of the probablePitcher stub in the schedule hydrate; hand must be joined from /people (not probed). mlb.pitcher_k_talent_prior.measurement_fix: prior_K = w*projK + (1-w)*stuffK; projK = mean of latest Steamer and ZiPS K% captured with its publish_date at or before the as-of date (own snapshots only; no back-fill). stuffK = league K% + beta*(usage-weighted whiff grade - league mean); the whiff-grade logistic model (release speed, IVB, HB, spin, extension, release height, arm angle, deltas to primary fastball) and beta are refit walk-forward: for games in season S use only pitches and seasons < S. w fitted by minimising held-out K% log loss in 2023-2025, default 0.5 and 0.3 on arsenal change. Posterior K% = (BF_eff*obsK + 150*prior_K)/(BF_eff+150), BF_eff = BF since change + 0.25*earlier BF. Units: K per BF.

mlb.postseason_round_roster_membership.assessment: Logistic recipe is explicit and point-in-time safe: P is 0/1 once submitted. Weak points: no evidence in probes that the transactions endpoint records round roster submissions (mlb_statsapi_trans only shows the endpoint is reachable), so the 2012-2025 fitting set and submitted_ts are unverified; 'Baseball-Reference postseason rosters by series' is not a confirmed page. b3 'projected WAR rank within position group' and b4 depend on mlb.rehab_progression_stage, undefined here. About 14 seasons x 12 clubs gives ~170 rosters, limiting a 7-term fit. Related to but not the same quantity as mlb.postseason_roster_reset_eligibility (a team-level runs delta), so not a duplicate. Agent judgement only.

mlb.reliever_award_production.measurement_fix: Pool per league-season: relievers with >=50% appearances in relief and >=40 IP. Features at last regular-season day: x1 = fWAR z within pool, x2 = saves, x3 = gmLI (average LI at entry, computed from a published base-out-inning-score leverage table applied to Stats API play-by-play, or FanGraphs gmLI), x4 = IP with LI>=1.5, x5 = WPA, x6 = FIP- in relief. ERA and K-BB% are dropped (collinear with x1/x6). P(i)=softmax(b*x) per award on its own winner history, ridge penalty 3 seasons toward zero except x1; BBWAA Relief award has only the x1 softmax, labelled uncalibrated. As-of last regular-season day.
